sheets.prompt: Surface design sheet for a science fiction exploration game, the paving of the plazas and streets of pale cities: large flagstones of cream, sand and pale rose stone laid in courses of uneven length with staggered joints, now and then a slab a shade warmer or cooler, a few cracked slabs and a patched one, slightly worn rounded edges, fine grit gathered in the joints as sparse pen stipple, a smoother worn path where people walk, an inset brass survey disc and a narrow drainage channel. Three panels side by side: a large square-on swatch of the paving; the same plaza seen from a walker's height with a small figure for scale; a strip showing the marks simplifying with distance, dense near, a few joints in the middle distance, flat colour far. Calm and readable, flat colour dominant, marks sparse and fine. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, cream, sand, pale rose and a touch of brass, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, photo texture, text, watermark, lettering, labels, grass, moss.
